### Should Christians “Unhitch” from the Imprecatory Psalms?
Author: Paul Carter
Site: The Gospel Coalition Canada
URL: https://ca.thegospelcoalition.org/columns/ad-fontes/christians-unhitch-imprecatory-psalms/
Passage: Psalm 58:6-10
Points:
- Cries for divine vindication echo prayers throughout Scripture that entrust final judgment entirely to God rather than personal vengeance.
- Reading severe imprecations guards against distorted views of God by keeping His holiness and justice clearly in view.
- Praying these words helps comfortable Christians stand in solidarity with persecuted believers facing mortal danger around the world.
- Recognizing the severe judgment due to wickedness deepens gratitude for the cross and urgently motivates believers to share the gospel.
